title: Wood Woad Shield

sources.title: Ensnared (Ensnaring Strike)
markers: cannot make an attack of opportunity

summary: A +2 AC shield with a Bonus Action ensnare.

fields.Woad’s Ensnaring Strike: Level 1 melee Bonus Action once per Short Rest, with no attack roll or Concentration. Strength save against your spell save DC negates the initial 1d4 Bludgeoning and prevents Ensnared for 3 turns.
fields.Ensnared: Cannot move or make Opportunity Attacks. Takes 1d6 Piercing per turn, has Disadvantage on attacks and Dexterity saves, and grants Advantage to attackers. Help removes the condition.
fields.Acquisition: Wood Woads at the Decrepit Sanctuary (85, 212).

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
